# StockTuber public JSON API

Free, no API key, no sign-in. It returns aggregated views of what tracked finance YouTubers say about US stocks.
**Not investment advice.** Summaries are generated by AI and may contain errors.

Base URL: `https://stocktuber.com`

| Endpoint | Methods | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/public/stocks` | `GET` | Today's most-discussed stocks with sentiment scores |
| `/api/brief` | `GET`, `POST` | A brief for the tickers you pass in |

**All endpoints are read-only.** Nothing you send is stored or changes any data. `POST /api/brief` exists only so a long ticker list can go in the request body instead of the URL.

## Conventions

- **Format:** JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`), UTF-8.
- **CORS:** open (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`), so it can be called from a browser. `OPTIONS` is supported on both endpoints.
- **Other methods** (for example `DELETE`) return `405`.
- **Caching:** responses are sent with `Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate`. Please cache on your side where you can.
- **Freshness:** `date` is the date of the most recent daily aggregation available. Data is refreshed by a scheduled job; there is no guaranteed update time. If `date` is not today, the newest data is simply from an earlier day.
- **Sentiment score:** `round((bullish% − bearish%) / 2 + 50)`, from 0 to 100. `50` is neutral, `100` is all bullish, `0` is all bearish.
- **Limits:** no API key and no authentication. No rate limit is documented; please keep request volume modest (for example, one brief per user per day). Limits and behavior may change without notice.
- **Usage:** if you display the data, please link back to [stocktuber.com](https://stocktuber.com) and keep the not-investment-advice notice.

---

## `GET /api/public/stocks`

Today's most-discussed US stocks (crypto tickers excluded; a stock needs at least 2 opinions; at most 50 are returned, ordered by number of opinions).

```bash
curl -s "https://stocktuber.com/api/public/stocks"
```

Example response (trimmed to one stock; values change daily):

```json
{
  "date": "2026-10-25",
  "count": 50,
  "note": "sentiment_score: 0-100, 50=neutral (bullish adds, bearish subtracts). Not investment advice.",
  "stocks": [
    {
      "ticker": "NVDA",
      "name": "NVIDIA",
      "sentiment_score": 78,
      "bullish_pct": 69,
      "neutral_pct": 19,
      "bearish_pct": 13,
      "creators": 16,
      "opinions": 16,
      "url": "https://stocktuber.com/stocks/nvda"
    }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `date` | Date of the aggregation (`YYYY-MM-DD`), or `null` if there is no data yet |
| `count` | Number of stocks returned |
| `stocks[].ticker` / `name` | Ticker and company name (`name` can be `null`) |
| `stocks[].sentiment_score` | 0–100 score (see above) |
| `stocks[].bullish_pct` / `neutral_pct` / `bearish_pct` | Share of creators' views in each stance, in percent |
| `stocks[].creators` | Number of distinct creators who discussed the stock |
| `stocks[].opinions` | Number of opinions counted |
| `stocks[].url` | The stock's page on stocktuber.com |

## `GET` or `POST /api/brief`

A brief for the tickers you pass in: score, change versus the previous aggregation day, creator counts, bull/bear talking points, the latest creator views (from the last 7 days, one latest view per creator per ticker), and a ready-to-send `markdown` summary.

### GET

```bash
curl -s "https://stocktuber.com/api/brief?tickers=NVDA,TSLA"
curl -s "https://stocktuber.com/api/brief?tickers=NVDA,TSLA&lang=zh"
```

### POST

```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://stocktuber.com/api/brief" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"holdings":["NVDA","TSLA"],"lang":"en"}'
```

### Parameters

| Name | Where | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tickers` | query (GET) | Comma-separated tickers, e.g. `NVDA,TSLA`. If present, it is used and any request body is ignored |
| `holdings` | JSON body (POST) | Array of tickers, e.g. `["NVDA","TSLA"]`. `tickers` is accepted as an alias. Array items may be strings or objects with a `ticker` field |
| `lang` | query or JSON body | `en` (default) or `zh` for Chinese talking points and summary |

Tickers are trimmed, upper-cased, de-duplicated, and **limited to the first 40**; extra tickers are ignored silently.

### Example response (trimmed; values change daily)

```json
{
  "date": "2026-10-25",
  "holdings": [
    {
      "ticker": "NVDA",
      "name": "NVIDIA",
      "covered": true,
      "sentiment_score": 78,
      "change_vs_prev": 1,
      "buy": 11,
      "hold": 3,
      "sell": 2,
      "bullish_pct": 69,
      "neutral_pct": 19,
      "bearish_pct": 13,
      "creators": 16,
      "opinions": 16,
      "bull_points": ["NVIDIA owns the platform ecosystems (Jetson Thor, Groot, Hyperion, DSX) that other companies build on, making it the core holding."],
      "bear_points": ["Nvidia keeps releasing better and faster chips, making existing chips obsolete quickly, which undermines the collateral value of data center debt."],
      "latest_views": [
        {
          "creator": "Ticker Symbol: YOU",
          "stance": "bullish",
          "date": "2026-10-25",
          "video": "NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Left Me SPEECHLESS at GTC Berlin",
          "watch": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NDCjUZKpZHA&t=917s"
        }
      ],
      "url": "https://stocktuber.com/stocks/nvda"
    },
    { "ticker": "ZZZZ", "name": null, "covered": false }
  ],
  "markdown": "Based on 30 finance YouTubers' recent views — your holdings (buy/hold/sell):\n\n🟢 NVDA (11/3/2)\n\nNo recent coverage: ZZZZ\n\nDetails · https://stocktuber.com/api/brief",
  "note": "buy/hold/sell = bullish/neutral/bearish creator counts. Not investment advice."
}
```

### Fields

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `date` | Date of the latest aggregation |
| `holdings[].covered` | `false` if the ticker has no recent coverage; only `ticker` and `name` are returned then |
| `sentiment_score` | 0–100 score |
| `change_vs_prev` | Score change versus the previous aggregation day, or `null` if unavailable |
| `buy` / `hold` / `sell` | Counts of bullish / neutral / bearish creators |
| `bullish_pct` / `neutral_pct` / `bearish_pct` | Shares of views by stance, in percent |
| `creators` / `opinions` | Distinct creators and opinions counted |
| `bull_points` / `bear_points` | Up to 4 de-duplicated talking points per side (AI-generated, in `lang`) |
| `latest_views[]` | Up to 5 latest views: `creator`, `stance`, `date`, source `video` title, and a `watch` link (with timestamp when known) |
| `markdown` | A short summary you can forward as-is; each line is `emoji TICKER (buy/hold/sell)` |
| `note` | Reminder that this is not investment advice |

### Errors and edge cases

| Situation | Response |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/brief` with no `tickers` | `307` redirect to `https://stocktuber.com` (so the link is clickable) |
| `POST` with no tickers, an empty list, or invalid JSON | `400` with `{"error":"Provide holdings/tickers, e.g. ?tickers=NVDA,TSLA"}` |
| A ticker with no recent coverage | `200`, and that holding has `"covered": false` |
| No data available yet | `200` with `{"date":null,"holdings":[],"markdown":"No data yet."}` |
| Unsupported method | `405` |
